text: Right, environmental wins are coming thick and fast this week! speaker: charlie
text: That's massive news, Jamie! And it's not just about the dollars - though saving money never hurt anyone. The report basically says the old argument that renewables aren't reliable is well and truly dead in the water. These systems can deliver power 24-7 now, which is game-changing stuff.
